use_when: Establishing existing context from credible public documents reports and standards
avoid_when: Understanding unobserved behavior or current local context
key_limitation: Source recency and transferability may be weak

use_when: Reviewing existing capabilities plans and constraints from internal material
key_limitation: Internal material can be selective or stale

use_when: Auditing company product and competitor offers and capabilities
key_limitation: Visible claims may differ from delivered value

use_when: Searching literature patent standards and regulatory records
key_limitation: Coverage is uneven across domains and jurisdictions

use_when: Analyzing available behavioral and transaction data
key_limitation: Data may omit context and non-users

use_when: Analyzing social review and discourse content
key_limitation: Samples are self-selected and noisy

use_when: Market sizing and triangulation from multiple angles
avoid_when: Proving a specific company will capture share
key_limitation: Depends on credible category and proxy data

use_when: Segmentation and decision-unit analysis
avoid_when: Choosing a final strategy without evidence
key_limitation: Segments are interpretive not facts

use_when: Competitive benchmarking and positioning of visible offers
key_limitation: Visible claims may differ from delivered value

use_when: Five Forces assessment of industry structure and competitive pressure
key_limitation: Depends on credible category evidence

use_when: Mapping value chain and profit pool where value is created and captured
avoid_when: Choosing a final strategy without evidence
evidence_or_output: value chain and profit pool map
key_limitation: Reflects current assumptions about activities

use_when: Ecosystem and channel mapping of actors and exchanges
key_limitation: Can omit informal or hidden actors

use_when: JTBD and journey analysis of progress touchpoints and frictions
avoid_when: Calculating market size or proving behavior
key_limitation: Interpretation of evidence not evidence itself

use_when: Pricing and unit economics analysis
avoid_when: Proving customers will adopt a price
key_limitation: Sensitive to assumptions about cost and volume

use_when: Trend weak signal and structural versus cyclical analysis
key_limitation: Signals are ambiguous and lag reality

use_when: Technology maturity and capability assessment
key_limitation: Maturity ratings are contested

use_when: Building scenarios analogies and causal models
key_limitation: Analogies require contextual verification

use_when: PESTEL assessment of macro environment factors
key_limitation: Macro factors may not translate to a specific decision

use_when: Strategic group analysis grouping competitors by position
key_limitation: Group boundaries are interpretive

use_when: Industry lifecycle stage and transition assessment
key_limitation: Stage labels are contestable and lag reality

use_when: Source-family triangulation across independent origins
avoid_when: Counting repeated pages as independent evidence
key_limitation: Triangulation does not create new data

use_when: Negative-case and disconfirming search against favored claims
key_limitation: Absence of disconfirmation is not proof

use_when: Contradiction analysis preserving conflicting evidence
avoid_when: Silently resolving to the favorable source
key_limitation: May leave a conflict unresolved

use_when: Sensitivity and boundary checks on key assumptions
avoid_when: Presenting a single-point estimate as robust
key_limitation: Does not identify which assumption is wrong

use_when: Alternative explanation testing for a favored inference
key_limitation: Some alternatives remain untestable now

use_when: Evidence-strength and transferability checks
avoid_when: Generalizing a strong finding beyond its setting
key_limitation: Transfer depends on contextual similarity

use_when: Pattern and anomaly detection across evidence
key_limitation: Patterns are interpretive synthesis not new evidence

use_when: Accepted Belief challenge of unexamined consensus
key_limitation: May surface a belief with no reframe

use_when: Belief shift mapping of what changed and why
avoid_when: Treating a shift as a validated fact
key_limitation: Shifts may reflect new bias not learning

use_when: Tension finding between competing evidence or beliefs
key_limitation: Tensions are not yet insights

use_when: Structural reframe generation from colliding lenses
avoid_when: Claiming a reframe is a validated strategy
key_limitation: Reframes need downstream validation

use_when: Cross-lens collision across 4C and extended lenses
avoid_when: Adding lenses that add no new inference
key_limitation: Collision can multiply noise

use_when: Strategic relevance mapping to future choices
avoid_when: Treating relevance as a chosen strategy
key_limitation: Relevance is a judgment not evidence

use_when: SWOT synthesis of internal and external position
avoid_when: Treating SWOT as a validated strategy decision
key_limitation: SWOT can become a list of adjectives without evidence discipline
